file: 434 GTA 6 Lucia or Mandy Who Is the Better Girl.mp4

lines.t: GTA 6 players are arguing about who's the better girl, Lucia or Mandy.

full.credit: Clips: Dan Allen Gaming; Fox 2.0 Gaming; kibblz (YouTube)

lines.t: Lucia is the series' first playable woman, and the game starts with her leaving prison.

full.credit: Clips: Dan Allen Gaming; Fox 2.0 Gaming; kibblz (YouTube)

lines.t: Mandy was in no trailer. She shows up early, in the Pipework mission, flirting with Jason while Lucia is still in prison.

full.credit: Clips: Dan Allen Gaming; Fox 2.0 Gaming; kibblz (YouTube)

lines.t: Her actor says she does Mandy's voice and motion capture, and fans loved her from launch week.
